relationship_to_prior: This is a correction/delta to the already completed 45-protocol discovery ledger. Unlisted protocols retain their prior disposition but do not override these narrower audit results.

impacted.name: Interface / port correspondence
impacted.statement: Action ports live in local canonical frames; edge transporters are load-bearing interface mappings and were omitted from recursive label alignment.

impacted.name: Dependency-topology discovery
impacted.statement: The rank-DAG and unique opposite-parity directed reconvergence independently reproduce on the declared representation carrier.

impacted.name: Alternative-factorization discovery
impacted.statement: Fixed-frame literal routes, canonical-frame state orbits, global-action-transporter future behavior, and coarse set-quotient behavior are distinct valid factorizations with different identity conclusions.

impacted.name: Residual-structure discovery after partial match
impacted.statement: Canonical residual masks are transported hyperedges and need not be geometric line residuals in the displayed frame.

impacted.name: Symmetry / automorphism discovery
impacted.statement: The physical fixed-board column automorphism group is only identity/reflection; the experimental canonicalizer uses the full symmetric group on columns as abstract relabeling.

impacted.name: Role-equivalent elements under different labels
impacted.statement: Canonical action labels are local slots. Role equivalence across states requires an explicit transporter.

impacted.name: Invariants across admissible variation
impacted.statement: Global exactness/non-exactness and route parity difference survive tested gauge/basis changes; edge flip location and nonzero fundamental-basis count do not.

impacted.name: Transformation-invariant discovery
impacted.statement: Node-sheet gauge changes move delta=1 between edges while preserving total route difference; spanning-basis changes alter nonzero basis-cycle count while preserving exactness.

impacted.name: Information-flow structure
impacted.statement: Canonicalizing transporter information is dropped before recursive action-token signatures are formed, creating a missing information-flow edge between coordinate frames.

impacted.name: Causal / temporal structure
impacted.statement: Fixed-frame route order changes exact endpoints, but current evidence does not establish an intrinsic noncommuting game mechanism; a global action transporter restores future correspondence.

impacted.name: Fixed-point / recurrence structure
impacted.statement: Recursive canonical-frame action-token classes are a fixed point of their declared construction, but that construction is not equivalent to globally aligned literal-action future behavior.

impacted.name: Reconstruction-structure discovery
impacted.statement: A semantically stronger reconstruction must retain/compose edge transporters or stay in a fixed/physical frame.

impacted.name: Proof / witness topology
impacted.statement: The unique 3+3 contradiction is an exact MSS witness of the representation graph only; its binary behavior fiber collapses under literal-future reconstruction.

impacted.name: Refinement-relation discovery
impacted.statement: Refining identity from coarse base group to exact state separates endpoints; refining from stored action-token class to literal future behavior collapses the sheet pair. The quotient is simultaneously coarser and finer along different axes.

impacted.name: Boundary-movement invariance
impacted.statement: Moving the comparison boundary across canonicalization changes which action labels are meaningful; transporter must cross that boundary.

impacted.name: Reachability / connectivity structure
impacted.statement: Cycle rank and directed contradictory reachability are independently reproduced on the declared graph.

impacted.name: Conservation / balance structure
impacted.statement: Parity exactness is conserved under node-sheet gauge; ordinary physical geometry is not conserved under arbitrary canonical slot relabeling unless residual hyperedges and transporter are carried.

impacted.name: Failure-mode correspondence
impacted.statement: The strongest old interpretation fails because stored sheets are not distinct literal future behaviors; the representation graph itself remains mathematically non-exact.

impacted.name: Representation-redundancy discovery
impacted.statement: Canonical representative choice is harmless for action-unlabelled abstract state only with appropriate transport; dropping transport while retaining recursive action tokens is not representation-neutral.

impacted.name: Semantic-identity candidate discovery
impacted.statement: Exact, physical-symmetry, arbitrary-action, literal-future and coarse-quotient identity queries disagree; natural identity remains INCOMPLETE.

impacted.name: Global whole-structure isomorphism
impacted.statement: Fixed-frame route endpoints admit complete future correspondence under explicit global action permutations, but those permutations are not physical board automorphisms.
